title: Elected, As Usual
stamp: Routine procedure. The real question is elsewhere.

scenes.text: I was elected by the countries taking part. Say it with me: elected. By the countries. Present.
panel: post: “by choice of the participating countries”

scenes.text: Fair is fair: ICAO’s rules say a conference elects its own chairman soon after it opens. So yes, I was elected. As all chairmen are. By rule.
panel: Doc 8683, Rule 3: meeting elects its Chairman

scenes.text: One other detail: my post says 193 member states. ICAO’s own post says delegates from 115. So 193 invited, 115 in the room. Rounding is a diplomatic art.
